sources.title: What are AWS WAF, AWS Shield Advanced, AWS Shield network security director and AWS Firewall Manager?
Deciding whether to subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced and apply additional protections
Control subnet traffic with network access control lists

en.summary: AWS WAF is a web application firewall that allows, blocks or counts HTTP and HTTPS requests based on rules you define. AWS Shield protects against DDoS attacks: Shield Standard is automatic for all customers, and Shield Advanced adds paid protection and help from the Shield Response Team.
examCues: Block SQL injection or cross-site scripting against a CloudFront distribution, API Gateway API or Application Load Balancer → WAF & Shield
Allow or block web requests by source IP address or country → WAF & Shield
Limit how many requests one source can send within a few minutes → WAF & Shield
A high-visibility website needs expanded DDoS protection and expert response support → WAF & Shield (Shield Advanced)

notToConfuseWith.difference: Security groups and network ACLs (VPC console) filter traffic by protocol, port and IP address; WAF inspects what is inside HTTP and HTTPS requests, such as headers and query strings.
WAF and Shield are the protections; Firewall Manager applies them, and security group rules, across many accounts and new resources.

en.pricingModel: WAF charges for each web ACL, each rule in it and the number of web requests it receives. Shield Standard has no extra charge; Shield Advanced adds a monthly subscription plus usage fees based on data transferred out.

aws: Runs WAF and its managed rule groups
Applies Shield Standard against common network and transport layer DDoS attacks
customer: Writes the WAF rules and chooses which resources each web ACL protects
Tests new rules with the Count action before switching them to block
Designs the application architecture for DDoS resiliency and decides whether Shield Advanced is needed

es.summary: AWS WAF es un firewall de aplicaciones web que permite, bloquea o cuenta solicitudes HTTP y HTTPS según reglas que tú defines. AWS Shield protege contra ataques DDoS: Shield Standard es automático para todos los clientes y Shield Advanced agrega protección de pago y ayuda del Shield Response Team.
examCues: Bloquear SQL injection o cross-site scripting contra una distribución de CloudFront, una API de API Gateway o un Application Load Balancer → WAF & Shield
Permitir o bloquear solicitudes web por dirección IP de origen o país → WAF & Shield
Limitar cuántas solicitudes puede enviar un mismo origen en pocos minutos → WAF & Shield
Un sitio web muy visible necesita protección DDoS ampliada y soporte experto de respuesta → WAF & Shield (Shield Advanced)

notToConfuseWith.difference: Los security groups y las network ACLs (consola de VPC) filtran tráfico por protocolo, puerto y dirección IP; WAF inspecciona lo que va dentro de las solicitudes HTTP y HTTPS, como headers y query strings.
WAF y Shield son las protecciones; Firewall Manager las aplica, junto con reglas de security groups, en muchas cuentas y en recursos nuevos.

es.pricingModel: WAF cobra por cada web ACL, por cada regla dentro de ella y por la cantidad de solicitudes web que recibe. Shield Standard no tiene cargo extra; Shield Advanced agrega una suscripción mensual más cargos por uso según los datos transferidos hacia afuera.
